controls.VEGAS/a11y.timeDisplayPattern:
{ $hours ->
  [0] { $minutes ->
          [0] { $seconds } seconds
          [one] 1 minute and { $seconds } seconds
          *[other] { $minutes } minutes and { $seconds } seconds
          }
  [one] { $minutes ->
        [one] 1 hour, 1 minute and { $seconds } seconds
        *[other] 1 hour, { $minutes } minutes and { $seconds } seconds
        }
  *[other] { $minutes ->
            [one] { $hours } hours, 1 minute and { $seconds } seconds
            *[other] { $hours } hours, { $minutes } minutes and { $seconds } seconds
            }
}
